verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אַ֭שְׁרֵי כָּל־ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝הֹלֵ֗ךְ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’aš·rê kāl- yə·rê Yah·weh ha·hō·lêḵ biḏ·rā·ḵāw
verses.literal: A song of ascents Blessed are all who fear the LORD who walk in His ways

verses.original: כִּ֣י תֹאכֵ֑ל כַּ֭פֶּיךָ יְגִ֣יעַ אַ֝שְׁרֶ֗יךָ וְט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯō·ḵêl kap·pe·ḵā yə·ḡî·a‘ ’aš·re·ḵā wə·ṭō·wḇ lāḵ
verses.literal: For when you eat the fruit of your labor blessings and prosperity will be yours

verses.original: אֶשְׁתְּךָ֤׀ פֹּרִיָּה֮ כְּגֶ֥פֶן בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֪י בֵ֫יתֶ֥ךָ בָּ֭נֶיךָ זֵיתִ֑ים כִּשְׁתִלֵ֣י סָ֝בִ֗יב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eš·tə·ḵā pō·rî·yāh kə·ḡe·p̄en bə·yar·kə·ṯê ḇê·ṯe·ḵā bā·ne·ḵā zê·ṯîm kiš·ṯi·lê sā·ḇîḇ lə·šul·ḥā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine [flourishing] within your house your sons like olive shoots [sitting] around your table

verses.original: כֵ֭ן הִנֵּ֣ה כִי־ יְבֹ֥רַךְ גָּ֗בֶר יְרֵ֣א יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḵên hin·nêh ḵî- yə·ḇō·raḵ gā·ḇer yə·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: In this way indeed . . . shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ מִצִּ֫יּ֥וֹן וּ֭רְאֵה בְּט֣וּב יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn ū·rə·’êh bə·ṭūḇ yə·rū·šā·lim kōl yə·mê ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: May the LORD bless you from Zion that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life

verses.original: וּרְאֵֽה־ בָנִ֥ים לְבָנֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.literal: that you may see your children’s children Peace be upon Israel
